name: Slanted Wall
primary:
Covers you from the front and above: arrows and fireballs from the sky hit the stone.
A 5-wide wall at 45°: its base stands at the aim point and it rises toward you like an awning, covering you from the front and from the sky; it turns to any angle and the slope is solid with no gaps. Material: magic earth, permanent.
self_description: A 5-wide wall at 45°: its base stands at the aim point and it rises toward you like an awning, covering you from the front and from the sky; it turns to any angle and the slope is solid with no gaps. Material: magic earth, permanent. No extra effects.
